remarks: Let's talk perfection and convenience. Contemporary townhouse situated alongside the coveted Saugatuck River. End unit provides privacy and a fabulous outdoor living experience. The modern interior abounds a spacious open floor plan with 9'+ ceilings, hardwood floors, gas fireplace, stainless steel appliances, granite counters, app connected smart thermostat, central air, washer and dryer, ample storage in the attic, all while offering incredible walkability to both downtown Westport and the train station with all of its wonderful restaurants and shopping opportunities. Clean design, furnished in a well edited style, perfect for anyone. Nearby amenities include, Saugatuck Center, Westport Paddle Club, Longshore Golf Course, Compo Beach, Westport Library, Dream Spa, Main Street, Levitt Pavilion, farmers market, I-95, Merritt Parkway, Boston Post Road, Metro North Railroad, Marinas, Whole Foods, and SoNo Collection Mall.
